punchline: The camera was yours; the raw film was on someone else's list.
thirty_sec: In 1908 Edison's company pooled film patents into one trust; Kodak sold film only to members and a subsidiary held distribution. The government sued in 1912 and a federal court ruled the trust illegal on 1 October 1915.
question: Who besides you can open the gate your advantage depends on?
key_contrast: A structure of three choke points depended on three separate consents.
